question: Every sample's GEO title and processed-file name (e.g. Cob_LN_rep1, GSM1440504_Cob_LN_rep1_TagCopyNumber) disagree with its GEO/BioSample treatment characteristic (Cob_LN_rep1-3 say 'optimal nitrogen supply', Cob_ON_rep1-3 say 'low nitrogen supply'; same for florets). N labels here follow title + file name. Accept, or swap?
proposed_answer: Follow titles (two submitter fields and the processed files agree; the characteristic looks like a template fill error). Verify after quantification: LN-vs-ON log2FC from these labels should match the direction of the paper's LN-responsive genes (Supplementary Tables S5/S8, mean TPM per group); swap all labels if they are reversed.
evidence: GEO GSE59613 GSM1440504-15 titles, supplementary file names and characteristics; runs.tsv biosample_attributes (same conflict)

question: These are 21-nt NlaIII DGE 3' tags (CATG + 17 nt), 49-nt reads (rep1-2) or 35-nt reads (rep3), mapped by the authors to maize v2. Curated now; processing deferred. Keep in v1 catalogue with processing deferred?
proposed_answer: Keep curated, defer processing; if processed, use a tag-aware pipeline (trim to 17-21 nt, unique-tag mapping to v5 transcripts + 300 nt UTR extension).
evidence: Paper Methods (PMC4588875); GEO data processing; runs.tsv read_length

question: Replicate 3 of every group was sequenced with 35-nt reads vs 49 nt for replicates 1-2 (a separate run). Batch is balanced across tissue x N, so include replicate/batch as a blocking factor?
proposed_answer: Yes: add batch (rep3 vs rep1-2) as a blocking term, or at least check it in PCA.
evidence: runs.tsv read_length 35 for SRR1521468, SRR1521471, SRR1521474, SRR1521477

question: ON = 250 kg N/ha split 60 (pre-sowing) + 120 (V8) + 70 (V12); fertilizer form and field year are not stated. N_form NR for ON. Accept?
proposed_answer: Accept NR (Chinese field trials usually use urea, but not stated).
evidence: Supplementary Table S1 (PDF); paper Methods; GEO growth protocol
